On August 10, 2026, Adam reaches out to LiHua through a recorded message to discuss the warranty and maintenance plans for an air conditioner. Adam's intention is to make sure that LiHua has reviewed the documents and to address any questions she might have about them. He proposes a time to continue their conversation after dinner, showing flexibility and willingness to accommodate LiHua's schedule. LiHua confirms that she has looked at the plans, but she has a couple of questions. Adam is supportive and proactive in offering his availability and expressing his anticipation for their discussion. This interaction highlights Adam's customer service-oriented approach and LiHua's proactive engagement in seeking clarifications on important service agreements. They agree to talk around 8 PM, demonstrating effective communication and mutual respect in their professional relationship.
